items.requiredAction: Owner decision (OA-MIGRATION-RECONCILIATION-DECISION). Recommended: a checked-in ledger mapping every production row to a repo file (non-destructive) plus a gate comparing list_migrations names to the ledger. Any repair of the history table only after export + schema diff.

items.currentTruth: Free plan: no backups, no PITR. No owner-held export exists.

items.currentTruth: Raw telemetry kept forever. beta_pedagogy_events 1 851 rows / 3.0 MB (largest table). Projection: DB passes 500 MB near 1 000 MAU without retention; about 0.25 GB at 1 000 MAU with 30-day raw retention.
items.requiredAction: Owner approves a retention policy (OA-TELEMETRY-RETENTION-DECISION); then a migration/cron that aggregates to daily metrics and deletes raw rows older than the window.
items.risk: Deleting job = data loss by design; free-tier DB exhaustion if not done.
